source.text: ተአመኑ፡ ጻድቃን፡ እስመ፡ ለጽእለት፡ ይከውኑ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወይትሐጕሉ፡ በዕለተ፡ ዓመፃ።
source.note: Bounded selected-edition candidate only; prior reviews do not certify this candidate.

translation.text: Trust, you righteous, for sinners will become a disgrace, and they will perish on the day of iniquity.

source.text: ምንተ፡ ትገብሩ፡ ሀለወክሙ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወ*አይቴ፡ ትጐይዩ፡ በ*ይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ እንተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ሶበ፡ ትሰምዑ፡ ቃለ፡ ጸሎቶሙ፡ ለጻድቃን።
source.note: Bounded selected-edition candidate only; prior reviews do not certify this candidate.

translation.text: What will you do, you sinners, and where will you flee on that day of judgment, when you hear the voice[a] of the prayer of the righteous?

footnotes.text: Or “sound” of the prayer. The selected expression permits this narrower auditory sense.

source.text: ወበእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ትበጽኅ፡ ጸሎቶሙ፡ ለ*ቅዱሳን፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚእ፡ ወለክሙ፡ ይበጽሕ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኵነ*ክሙ።
source.note: Bounded selected-edition candidate only; prior reviews do not certify this candidate.

translation.text: And in those days the prayer of the holy ones[a] will reach the Lord, and the days of your judgment[b] will come upon you.

footnotes.text: Or “saints.” The selected text has “holy ones”; Charles 1906 apparatus on printed page 202 records “righteous” in other witnesses.
The selected edition prints ኵነ*ክሙ with an internal critical mark. “Your judgment” is a cautious rendering of this difficult expression.

source.text: አሌ፡ ለክሙ፡ እለ፡ ታጠርዩ፡ *ብሩረ፡ ወወርቀ፡ ዘአኮ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወትብሉ፡ ብዕልነ፡ ብዕለ፡ ወኮነ፡ ለነ፡ ንዋይ፡ ወአጥረይነ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘፈቀድነ።
source.note: Bounded selected-edition candidate only; prior reviews do not certify this candidate.

translation.text: Woe to you who acquire silver and gold not in righteousness[a], and say, ‘We have become rich with wealth, and we have possessions, and we have acquired everything we desired.’

footnotes.text: Or “not by righteousness.” The phrase qualifies the manner of acquiring the wealth; it does not identify any present-day group.
